verdict.rationale: The evidence documents agent workflows (Agent Flows, custom agent workflows), but nothing shows these can run on a recurring schedule, cron, or timer. Defining a workflow that runs on demand is a different thing from scheduling it to recur, so the workflow evidence does not count here. Scheduling is a fair question for an AI assistant platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
